omnara:index:CronTrigger.description: Creates a cron trigger that fires on a schedule. A trigger targeting an agent profile launches a new agent from the profile's current config on each firing; a trigger targeting an agent sends an input to that agent. Missed firings are coalesced, matching standard cron behavior: if one or more scheduled times pass while firing is delayed, the trigger fires once for the oldest missed time and then resumes its schedule from the current time, without retroactively firing for the other missed times.

cron.description: Standard five-field cron expression (minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week). `TZ=`/`CRON_TZ=` prefixes are rejected; set the `timezone` field instead.

failureReport.description: Most recent failed firing, or null if no firing has failed since the last successful firing.

lastFiredAt.description: When the trigger last fired, or null if it has never fired. For integration targets this means durable inbox handoff.

lastRun.description: Status of the latest accepted scheduled integration launch, scoped to this project and integration. Null for ordinary cron, before any launch is accepted, or when retained details have expired. Never falls back to an older launch. Schedule firing failures remain separate in failure_report. Deleting or disabling a schedule does not cancel launch work already accepted by the integration.

messageTemplate.description: Go text/template rendered on each firing to produce the message sent to the target. The template receives a `trigger` value with `name`, `fired_at`, `last_fired_at`, and `local_date` fields. Timestamps remain UTC; local_date is the scheduled occurrence's ISO date in the schedule timezone. Required for agent and profile targets; omitted for integration targets, which use their own settings. Rendering is capped at 64 KiB of output and one second of wall-clock time, and `printf` width and precision specifiers are capped at 1024; a firing whose template fails to render is recorded in `failure_report` without sending a message.

name.description: Human-readable name. Spaces and punctuation are allowed; leading or trailing whitespace and invisible or control characters are not.

nextFireAt.description: Next scheduled firing, or null while the trigger is disabled.

omnara:index:MachinePool.description:
An on-demand machine pool backed by a sandbox provider.

The capacity fields each provider requires differ:
- `agent37`, `arker`, `freestyle`, `modal`, `tenki`, `unikraft`: `defaultMachineCpu`, `defaultMachineMemoryMb`, `maxTotalCpu`, `maxTotalMemoryMb`, `maxMachineCpu`, `maxMachineMemoryMb`.
- `boxd`, `createos`, `daytona`, `e2b`, `superserve`: `maxTotalCpu`, `maxTotalMemoryMb`, `maxMachineCpu`, `maxMachineMemoryMb`.
- `blaxel`: `defaultMachineMemoryMb`, `maxTotalMemoryMb`, `maxMachineMemoryMb`, and no CPU fields.

defaultMachineEnv.description: Default environment for pool machines. A machine's environment, including resolved secret_env values, is applied to the provider machine at provisioning, so the provider_options startup_script and the daemon run with it, and is resolved again for each process at launch.

defaultMachineSecretEnv.description: Default secret environment for pool machines, mapping env names to generic secret references. References are resolved to secret values wherever the machine environment is applied.

deleteAfterIdleMinutes.description: Idle minutes before deleting a machine from this pool, or null when the pool default is unset.

name.description: Human-readable name. Spaces and punctuation are allowed; leading or trailing whitespace and invisible or control characters are not.

runtimeProtectionEnabled.description: Whether Omnara deletes this pool's machines when the provider remains running after the daemon becomes inactive.

usage.description: Current quota-consuming usage. Populated when the machine pool is returned by the list or get endpoint.

defaultMachineEnv.description: Default environment for pool machines. A machine's environment, including resolved secret_env values, is applied to the provider machine at provisioning, so the provider_options startup_script and the daemon run with it, and is resolved again for each process at launch.

defaultMachineSecretEnv.description: Default secret environment for pool machines, mapping env names to generic secret references. References are resolved to secret values wherever the machine environment is applied.

deleteAfterIdleMinutes.description: Idle minutes before deleting a machine from this pool. Omit to leave the pool default unset; a grant or agent source may still override it.

metadata.description: User-supplied metadata stored on a machine, provided directly or copied from the machine pool that provisions it. A restriction of Metadata that leaves room for one reserved pair - Omnara sets observed_platform on the machine to the platform reported by its daemon, so the key is reserved and at most 15 user pairs are accepted.

apiFormat.description: Wire protocol the model endpoint speaks: openai-responses, openai-chat-completions, or anthropic-messages. Allowed values: `openai-responses`, `openai-chat-completions`, `anthropic-messages`.

authOptions.description: Non-secret authentication settings for this provider config.

baseUrl.description: Provider endpoint base URL. Normal API mode uses public HTTPS endpoints; localhost and loopback endpoints are only for insecure dev-mode configs.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every request to this provider.

managementKind.description: Lifecycle owner. Tenant-managed resources can be changed through tenant APIs. Cluster-managed resources are installed and lifecycle-managed by the control plane; individual APIs may explicitly expose tenant-editable settings. Allowed values: `tenant`, `cluster`.

apiFormat.description: Wire protocol the model endpoint speaks: openai-responses, openai-chat-completions, or anthropic-messages. Allowed values: `openai-responses`, `openai-chat-completions`, `anthropic-messages`.

apiVariant.description: Provider-specific flavor of the API format: default, openrouter, or bedrock. Allowed values: `default`, `openrouter`, `bedrock`.

authKind.description: How the credential is sent: bearer_token, api_key_header, or sigv4 (AWS). Allowed values: `bearer_token`, `api_key_header`, `sigv4`.

authOptions.description: Non-secret authentication settings. Use an empty object with bearer_token. With api_key_header, set {"header_name":"..."}; Anthropic Messages defaults to {"header_name":"x-api-key"}. With sigv4, set the AWS signing service and region.

baseUrl.description: Provider endpoint base URL. Normal API mode requires a public HTTPS endpoint; localhost and loopback endpoints are accepted only when the API is running in insecure dev mode.

endpointPath.description: URL path under base_url. Defaults to /responses for OpenAI Responses, /chat/completions for Chat Completions, and /messages for Anthropic Messages.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every request to this provider. Values are stored and returned as plain text; use secret_headers for keys and tokens.

idleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum wait for response headers or the next response bytes, in milliseconds. Heartbeats count as activity. Defaults to 300000 (5 minutes). Local response processing does not consume this idle budget.

name.description: Human-readable name. Spaces and punctuation are allowed; leading or trailing whitespace and invisible or control characters are not.

preset.description: Built-in provider settings: openai, openrouter, or anthropic. A preset fills in api_format, api_variant, base_url, endpoint_path, auth_kind, and auth_options, so omit those when using one. Allowed values: `openai`, `openrouter`, `anthropic`.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Total deadline for one provider attempt, including reasoning and response streaming, in milliseconds. Defaults to 3600000 (60 minutes). Retries have separate deadlines.

secretHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers whose values come from org-owned generic secrets, mapping header names to secret references.

defaultMachineEnvOverlay.description: Env overlay merged over the pool's default_machine_env for machines materialized through this grant; a null entry removes the key.

defaultMachineSecretEnvOverlay.description: Secret env overlay merged over the pool's default_machine_secret_env for machines materialized through this grant; a null entry removes the key.

deleteAfterIdleMinutes.description: Idle minutes before deleting a machine created through this grant. Zero disables deletion for this grant; null inherits the pool default.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata. Maximum 16 pairs, keys up to 64 characters, values must be strings of up to 512 characters.

defaultCwd.description: Default working directory for processes on this project's machines from the pool.

omnara:index:ProjectModelGrant.description: Lets a project's agent configs use a configured model and returns the new grant. Optional overrides can narrow the model for that project (lower token limits, tools or reasoning turned off, fewer reasoning efforts or modalities) and set its per-request defaults within those limits.

contextWindowTokens.description: Project context budget for input and output tokens, or omitted/null to inherit from the configured model. Triggers compaction when estimated input exceeds the remaining budget after output and safety reserves. The turn fails if compaction cannot make it fit.

defaultCacheRetention.description: Prompt-cache preference for model requests; `short` when omitted. `short` applies the route's default caching (explicit cache breakpoints where the provider requires them) and, where the route accepts one, a stable conversation key for cache-aware routing. `long` prefers the route's extended cache lifetime where one exists (currently Anthropic's one-hour cache, which on Bedrock requires Claude 4.5 or newer) and behaves like `short` elsewhere. `none` sends no Omnara-managed cache controls or conversation key; providers may still cache prefixes on their own. Allowed values: `none`, `short`, `long`.

defaultMaxOutputTokens.description: Project default per-request output-token cap, or omitted/null to inherit from the configured model.

defaultReasoningEffort.description: Project default reasoning effort, or omitted/empty to inherit from the configured model.

inputModalities.description: Project subset of configured-model input types (text, image, or file). Empty means inherit.

maxOutputTokens.description: Project output-token ceiling, or omitted/null to inherit from the configured model.

outputModalities.description: Project subset of configured-model output types. Empty means inherit.

supportedReasoningEfforts.description: Project subset of configured-model reasoning efforts. Empty means inherit. When non-empty, default_reasoning_effort must resolve to one of these values.

supportsReasoning.description: Project-level reasoning override, or omitted/null to inherit from the configured model.

supportsTools.description: Project-level tool-use override, or omitted/null to inherit from the configured model.

Allowed values: `none`, `short`, `long`.
